skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of leadership, differentiate between leadership and management, grasp the prerequisites for successful leadership, understand major approaches and theories of leadership.
Understand personal qualities of leaders, characteristics of effective leaders, attitudes of leaders, and leadership ethics.
Learn how to motivate and empower individuals.
Develop communication skills and establish feedback systems.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Conflict Resolution, Negotiation, Training, and Counseling
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Resolve conflicts, negotiate effectively, train others, and provide counseling.
Develop skills in presenting and public speaking.
Develop skills in negotiation and conflict resolution.
Develop skills in working in groups, organizing and managing group work effectively, evaluating the quality of completed work and the performance of group members.
Develop skills in leading within organizations.
Develop skills in independent work, taking responsibility for professional tasks, having a spirit of service, social responsibility, and professional ethics.
Develop skills in self-learning and adapting to changes.
